description: Check whether an airline owes cash compensation for a delayed or cancelled flight under Canada's Air Passenger Protection Regulations, and how much. Ask the passenger for every answer; don't guess. Returns the verdict, amount per passenger and the last day to file. General information, not legal advice.

acceptedVoucherInWriting.description: Did the passenger accept a voucher or credit instead of cash, in writing?

actualArrival.description: Required if outcome is "travelled": when the passenger actually arrived at the final destination (aircraft door opened), local time there: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm.

alreadyCompensated.description: Has the passenger already been paid compensation for this disruption (by the airline or under another country's rules)?

blamedEarlierFlight.description: Did the airline say the problem was caused by an earlier flight?

charter.description: Was it a charter or package-holiday flight? Use "unsure" if the passenger does not know.

connectionIatas.description: IATA codes of connecting airports, in order. Empty for a direct flight.

delayAtRefundAtLeast3h.description: Only for a delayed flight where the passenger took a refund: was it at least 3 hours late at that point?

destinationIata.description: IATA code of the FINAL destination on the original ticket (not a connection).

disruption.description: Was the flight delayed or cancelled?

marketingCarrierIata.description: 2-character code of the airline on the ticket: the letters of the flight number, e.g. AC for AC 857.

notice.description: When did the airline tell the passenger? "within_14_days" includes being told at the airport.

operatingCarrierIata.description: Only if a different airline actually flew the plane ("operated by ..."): its 2-character code.

originIata.description: IATA code of the departure airport, e.g. YYZ. Use find_airport if unsure.

outcome.description: "travelled" = reached the destination (original or new flight); "refunded" = took a refund instead; "other" = e.g. made their own way.

reason.description: The reason the airline gave, mapped to the closest value. Airline operations: crew_shortage (Crew or staff shortage), scheduled_maintenance (Scheduled maintenance), schedule_or_aircraft_change (Schedule change or aircraft swap), airline_it_problem (Airline's computer or IT problem). Safety: mechanical_issue (Mechanical or technical problem), safety_other (Another safety reason). Outside the airline: weather (Weather), air_traffic_control (Air traffic control), airport_operations (Airport problem (e.g. de-icing, runway, fuelling)), security_threat (Security threat), medical_emergency (Medical emergency), wildlife_strike (Bird or wildlife strike), labour_disruption (Strike or labour disruption), manufacturer_defect (Aircraft defect announced by the manufacturer or regulator), government_or_police_order (Order from government, police or airport security), war_or_unrest (War or political unrest), illegal_act (Sabotage or another illegal act). Not sure: no_reason_given (They didn't give a clear reason), not_remembered (I don't remember), other (Something else).

scheduledArrival.description: Scheduled arrival at the final destination, as on the original ticket, local time there: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm.

title: Check flight compensation
